comparison_stage: Original concept plus complete-pass1 actual hero and all nine individual full frames; before V4 images, prior scores or design justifications
verdict: Recognizable and coherent static interpretation, with substantial concept drift in foliage grammar, face mass and arm/hand proportions. Not a close-match final approval.
observations: Broad guardian stance, antlers, cyan eyes/core and wood-stone feet carry identity.
Face is a broad continuous pointed shield/beak rather than the narrower layered split mask in the original.
Long articulated fingers and repeated dome-and-triangle foliage read more manufactured than the original irregular root-claw and moss masses.
Side and rear silhouettes are coherent but carry an oversized repeated leaf mantle; hidden-angle fidelity is approximate.
